findings.what: Q3 GAP IN THE SPLIT PAIR. Q3 (11:26Z) allows a SEC file as a final ONLY as V_pub (the highest display after the tie order). П1 {V_nonCI, exp75} uses the best NON-CI file, which is not V_pub whenever a CI file reads strictly higher. Branch A example: exp89r (CI+SEC) 0.960 = V_pub and exp89p (SEC) 0.959 -> V_nonCI = exp89p, so П1 would make a SEC file a final that is not V_pub, against the letter of the user's answer. Branch B never hits this: exp89q is non-CI, so V_nonCI is V_pub or a non-SEC file. The logged partner rule v2 and R26-A5 (2) do not cover this case.

findings.what: The round-26 fact 'DIS 2.25 dummies ran +15-20% vs their siblings' (new_facts 6; the exp89s gate expectation) is SETUP NOISE, not DIS compute. Stage split from six dummy logs (total s / setup before 'GPU shard 0' / prediction min / ILP sum s / repair sum s): exp85a 1388/262/9.03/128.5/565.2 vs exp89s (DIS 2.25) 1566/436/9.73/129.5/525.7; exp89p 1313/253/9.17/122.7/491.6 vs exp89q (DIS) 1576/519/9.10/122.7/493.3; exp88b 1654/501/9.77/135.4/547.2 vs exp88a (DIS) 1894/788/9.35/142.7/525.6. Total minus setup: 1126 vs 1130, 1060 vs 1057, 1153 vs 1106. So DIS files have the parent family's hidden latency: exp89q ~7.0-7.7 h, exp89r ~9.3-9.5 h (tail 10.9 h), with no extra ins-tail risk from DIS. Side note: dummy runtime rule v2 (<= 2,100 s) is dominated by 253-788 s of environment setup, so a gate on (total - setup) would be the informative one. Info only; no rule change this late.
